annotations.title: Verify a Forge Orbital decision record

description: Verifies the Ed25519 signature of a Forge Orbital demo decision record against the published demo key id. Pass the full signed record object returned by run_check (this demo keeps nothing, so a record id alone cannot be looked up). Editing any field makes verification fail. Demo records only.

record.description: The complete signed record object returned inside run_check, unchanged, including its signature and original decision fields. Pass the record object, not the outer tool response, a record ID, a summary or a JSON string. Deliberate edits are useful only when demonstrating failed verification.
record.title: Record

record_id.description: Legacy private-tier lookup only. The public demo stores no records, so an ID alone cannot be verified. On the public endpoint omit this and pass the complete signed record in record.
record_id.title: Record Id
